name: Can I prevent my window sills from rotting again after repair?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent my window sills from rotting again after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can take several steps to help prevent future rot after a window sill repair. Regular maintenance is key; this includes inspecting your sills annually for cracks in paint or caulk and promptly addressing any issues. Ensure your gutters and downspouts are clear and directing water away from your home's foundation and windows. Consider adding drip edges if not already present, and maintain proper ventilation inside your home to reduce condensation. We can advise on specific preventative measures relevant to your home's design and local conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent future rot by regular maintenance, sealing cracks, ensuring proper drainage, adding drip edges, and maintaining good indoor ventilation.
